audit_version: Priority 7D.1 — Adversarial Safety, False-Positive Resistance & Trust Boundary Audit
verdict: PRIORITY 7D.1 PASS — P7D AUDIT ARTIFACT CORRECTED

summary.trust_boundaries_description: 9 trust-boundary categories validated through 15 targeted adversarial tests.

categories.name: Substring Collision Prevention
categories.description: Prevent numeric prefix/suffix containment false matches (e.g., IS 778 matching IS 15778, IS 694 matching IS 9694).

categories.name: Canonical Identity Exactness
categories.description: Decompose standard identifiers via StandardIdentifierNormalizer comparing prefix, base number, part, and section.

categories.name: Provenance Semantic Safety
categories.description: Enforce strict separation between Record Provenance (OFFICIAL_PRIMARY, OFFICIAL_SECONDARY, VERIFIED, CURATED, INFERRED) and Verification Source (BIS Standards Catalogue). Curated records are never conflated with statutory official primary orders.

categories.name: Evidence Strength Semantics
categories.description: Categorize evidence into STRONG (explicit citations and verified primary entries), MODERATE (scope/domain overlap without citation), and NONE (abstentions). UI dynamically renders Authoritative Evidence Quote only for verified primary citations.

levels.STRONG: Explicit tender citations and direct verified catalogue entries
levels.MODERATE: Direct scope/title matches without explicit citation
levels.NONE: Abstentions, ambiguous cases, or ungrounded candidates

categories.name: Product vs Installation Separation
categories.description: Retain product standard (e.g., IS 15778 : 2007) as primary candidate while attaching installation codes (e.g., IS 7634 Part 3, SP 57) strictly as typed graph dependencies.

categories.name: Incomplete and Ambiguity Abstention
categories.description: Track missing engineering parameters, force human_review_required = true, and set candidate_standard = null and evidence_standard = null when specification is ambiguous or ungrounded.

categories.name: Truthful Abstention Wording
categories.description: Truthfully state catalogue bounds ('No reliable Indian Standard match found in the available catalogue') without fabricating absolute nonexistence ('No Indian Standard exists').
categories.exact_phrase: No reliable Indian Standard match found in the available catalogue

categories.name: Lifecycle Preservation
categories.description: Preserve historical citations in superseded_citation, identify active modern replacements in successor_standard, and flag for mandatory human engineering review without silent overwriting.

categories.name: Regulatory Safety
categories.description: Enforce that standard existence does not imply mandatory statutory applicability. Mandatory status requires verified Ministry Gazette Quality Control Orders (QCOs).

adversarial_benchmark_10_cases.text: Supply and installation of CPVC pipes and fittings for domestic hot and cold water distribution system conforming to IS 15778.
High strength deformed steel bars and wires for concrete reinforcement conforming to IS 1786 Grade Fe 500D.
Outdoor type three phase distribution transformers 11kV/433V up to and including 2500 kVA conforming to IS 1180 Part 1.
Supply of executive wooden office desks, swivel chairs, and paper stationery.
Legal advisory and corporate litigation consulting services.
Procurement of specialized fiber-optic gyroscope navigational modules for maritime vessels.
Laying of underground power transmission cable connection in industrial substation.
Overhauling and routine maintenance of existing plant pumping machinery and auxiliary drives.
Procurement of bolted bonnet steel gate valves conforming to IS 10611 : 1983.
Supply of crosslinked polyethylene insulated PVC sheathed power cables for working voltages up to and including 1100 V conforming to IS 7098 Part 1.

candidate_evidence_invariant_statement: All 10 cases satisfy the candidate/evidence consistency invariant: non-null recommendations have candidate_standard equivalent to evidence_standard; abstentions preserve candidate_standard = null and evidence_standard = null.
